interim_updates.note_text: Central Industries PLC (National PVC / Krypton) delivered a strong Q1 FY2026/27: Group revenue grew 33.8% YoY to Rs.1,772.3mn and PAT grew 34.3% to Rs.184.3mn, broadly in line with the filing's own printed +34% revenue and PAT growth figures. By segment, Water Management Products (the dominant segment, ~87.5% of revenue) grew revenue 32.2% to Rs.1,550.8mn and PBT 36.2% to Rs.252.9mn, while Electrical Products grew revenue faster at 46.0% (to Rs.221.5mn) but PBT slower at 18.0% (to Rs.12.0mn), indicating margin pressure in the smaller Electrical segment even as it scaled. Gross margin expanded meaningfully: gross profit grew 61.0% (nearly double the 33.8% revenue growth), pushing gross margin from 20.8% to 25.1% of revenue. That gross-margin gain was partly given back by Selling & Distribution Expenses, which grew 136% YoY (Rs.62.0mn to Rs.146.5mn) -- by far the fastest-growing cost line in the P&L -- while Administrative Expenses grew a more moderate 25% (Rs.46.1mn to Rs.57.5mn). Even after that S&D cost surge, Operating Profit still grew 43.2% to Rs.240.3mn, showing the gross-margin gain was large enough to more than absorb the higher distribution spend. Net Finance Income fell 13% YoY, Rs.28.1mn to Rs.24.6mn (Finance Income -10% as cash balances/rates normalised, Finance Expense +37% off a small base), a modest drag on an otherwise strong quarter.

interim_updates.takeaway: Revenue and PAT growth (+34%) is real and broad-based rather than a one-off: gross margin expanded from 20.8% to 25.1% of revenue, and operating profit grew 43% even after absorbing a 136% jump in Selling & Distribution Expenses -- the one line worth watching, since if S&D cost growth continues to outpace revenue growth at this rate it will start eating into the margin gains the company is currently posting.
operational_highlights: Group revenue +33.8% YoY to Rs.1,772.3mn; Group PAT +34.3% to Rs.184.3mn; Basic EPS Rs.7.62 vs Rs.5.67.
Gross margin expanded to 25.1% of revenue (Rs.444.3mn) from 20.8% (Rs.275.9mn) a year earlier, +61.0% YoY.
Water Management Products (dominant segment) revenue +32.2% to Rs.1,550.8mn, segment PBT +36.2% to Rs.252.9mn.
Electrical Products revenue +46.0% to Rs.221.5mn but segment PBT grew only +18.0% to Rs.12.0mn -- margin dilution as the smaller segment scales.
Selling & Distribution Expenses +136% YoY (Rs.62.0mn to Rs.146.5mn), the fastest-growing cost line; Operating Profit still grew 43.2% to Rs.240.3mn despite this.
Net Finance Income fell 13% to Rs.24.6mn (Finance Income -10%, Finance Expense +37% off a small base).
key_drivers: Water Management Products segment: +32.2% revenue, +36.2% PBT -- the primary earnings driver given its ~87.5% revenue share and disproportionate PBT contribution (Rs.252.9mn of Rs.264.9mn Group PBT).
Electrical Products segment: fastest revenue growth (+46.0%) but weakest profit conversion (+18.0% PBT), suggesting price/cost pressure or mix shift within that segment.
Selling & Distribution Expenses (+136% YoY) is the single largest cost-growth driver in the quarter, materially outpacing the 34% revenue growth.
Gross margin expansion (20.8% to 25.1% of revenue) is the main offsetting driver that kept operating profit growth (+43.2%) ahead of the S&D cost surge.
